$comment: Reviewed runtime palette mapped from design/design-v1.2/editorial_stationery onto the existing token names. Interaction scales (warming, mastery, ladder) keep their v1.1 contracts. See docs/design/design-system.md

canvas.comment: v1.2 surface-dim — page backdrop behind the desk

sunken.comment: v1.2 surface-container — inset areas, icon tiles

track.comment: v1.2 enclosed pill track — DESIGN.md Rounded Pill Tabs #EFECE1. Distinct from sunken2 (surface-container-high).

shadowInk.comment: v1.2 stationery ambient shadow pigment (DESIGN.md rgba(35,30,24)). Not a fill and not text; colours native RN shadows. Deliberately absent from checkContrast's surface list.

device.comment: v1.2 inverse-surface; blueprint chrome, not a product surface

scrim.comment: The modal/sheet backdrop — inverse-surface at 42%. Deliberately absent from checkContrast's surface list: it is a translucent overlay, so no text is laid on it directly and a ratio against it would be meaningless.

dark.comment: v1.2 inverse-surface — dark cards, toast, active segmented track. Pair only with onDark.* text.

muted.deviation: v1.2 outline #8a726a is 3.66:1 on surface.sunken2 — too light for body. Nudged along the same warm-brown hue to clear 4.5:1 there

muted2.use: WARNING: >=14px semibold or non-text only — v1.2 outline

muted3.deviation: v1.2 outline-variant #dec0b7 is 1.39:1 on surface.sunken2 — nudged along the same hue to clear 3:1

semantic.$comment: Each family is a triple — text, background, border. Success uses v1.2 sage; danger uses terracotta.

successMeta.use: Secondary line under a success headline, on success.bg

danger.use: Difficult, destructive, score <70 — v1.2 primary on primary-fixed

dangerAlt.use: retry copy, tricky-words tag — v1.2 primary-container

info.use: Pronunciation focus, Easy grade, Instant confidence

hookMeta.deviation: earlier blueprint #bd9660 was 2.44:1 — genuinely unreadable at 10px. The largest correction in the palette.

scale.$comment: Four ordered scales. Their ORDER carries meaning, so it is part of the contract.

mastery.$comment: Loro.dc.html:2839-2842, hues retuned to v1.2 ink / sage / terracotta

warming.$comment: THE most important colour transition in the app. The Refrain card heats as automaticity climbs. Light stops stay AA-safe on the v1.2 terracotta.

peak.deviation: the gradient's light stop is DESIGN.md secondary accent #c85a32 — white on it is 4.23:1, above the 3:1 large-text floor and below body AA.
constraint: WHITE TEXT ON THIS BAND MUST BE >=17px SEMIBOLD. It clears 3:1, not 4.5:1.
The v1.1 blueprint renders a 13px English subtitle in white at 0.7 opacity here
(Loro.dc.html:1442). That does not pass, and darkening the gradient far enough
to fix it turns the app's single most important reward moment muddy.
So the constraint is recorded rather than waived: the peak card's secondary
text needs a different treatment. Tracked as Q-14 in docs/decisions/open-questions.md
and enforced by checkContrast.ts, which fails if this floor is removed.

onDark.$comment: Ink inverts to a warm cream ramp on inverse-surface cards.
